title: Fix 'Round unavailable: Unexpected token <' error in the UI
summary: Dev UI shows a raw JSON parse error because /api requests get index.html from Vite
description: Context: at http://localhost:5173/ the header shows "Round unavailable: Unexpected token '<', "<!doctype "... is not valid JSON". Cause: vite.config.ts has no server.proxy, so the Vite dev server answers /api/v1/worlds/{id}/round/current with index.html and getCurrentRound's res.json() throws SyntaxError, which describeRoundError passes through unchanged. Desired: the round loads from the Go backend in dev, and any non-JSON response is explained in plain words. Why: players must see real round state or a clear message.
acceptance_criteria: Given the dev server is running, When the app requests /api/v1/*, Then Vite forwards it to the Go backend at http://localhost:8080
Given the round endpoint returns HTML, When the app loads, Then the header shows a readable message and not a JSON parser message

preserve: ApiError and TypeError messages in describeRoundError

technical_constraints: UI-only change; do not change the backend API
definition_of_done: Both requirements are done and verified
